reproducibility: Pinned output hashes; image generation is not byte-reproducible. Offline runtime uses these local files only.
style_brief: Original coherent semi-realistic modern medical illustration, intermediate detail, muted natural organ colours, soft ivory/terracotta, transparent background, no embedded labels, no text, no watermark, no photorealistic gore, independently drawn teal navigation overlays. Head establishes the style reference for subsequent views.
